### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

#### What is Akamai Cloud?

Akamai Cloud is a globally distributed public cloud platform built into Akamai’s intelligent edge network. Unlike centralized hyperscalers, it runs compute and AI inference closer to users, delivering lower latency, built-in security support, and predictable performance by default.

#### What workloads is Akamai Cloud best suited for?

Akamai Cloud is ideal for low-latency AI inference, real-time applications, media delivery, personalization, security workloads, and modern web and API services that benefit from running closer to end users across cloud and edge.

#### Does Akamai Cloud support AI and GPU workloads?

Yes. Akamai Cloud includes GPU cloud instances designed for AI inference workloads. Akamai Inference Cloud enables teams to run models closer to users, reducing latency and cost with low egress fees while scaling inference globally across a distributed platform. [https://www.akamai.com/products/gpu](/products/gpu)

#### Can I use Akamai Cloud alongside other clouds?

Yes. Akamai Cloud is open by design and built to complement existing cloud environments in support of multicloud architectures. Teams can integrate Akamai Cloud with hyperscalers to run workloads closer to users without vendor lock-in or forced migrations.

#### How does Akamai Cloud improve performance and security by default?

Akamai Cloud is built into an intelligent global edge network that screens malicious traffic and optimizes application performance automatically. Security and performance are not add-ons but core capabilities of the platform.  

#### Where is Akamai Cloud deployed globally?

Akamai Cloud runs on one of the world’s most distributed platforms, spanning thousands of locations across hundreds of cities and countries. This architecture places compute within milliseconds of end users worldwide. [https://www.akamai.com/why-akamai/global-infrastructure](/why-akamai/global-infrastructure)  

#### Is Akamai Cloud cost-effective compared to hyperscalers?

Yes. Akamai Cloud is designed for cost efficiency with transparent pricing and low egress fees. This helps teams control costs as they scale AI, media, and performance-sensitive workloads globally. [https://www.akamai.com/cloud/pricing](/cloud/pricing)   

#### How do developers get started with Akamai Cloud?

Developers sign up to Akamai and start a free account. They can also get started through Akamai’s APIs, SDKs, and examples available on GitHub. Akamai is also a proud maintainer of the CNCF [Spin](https://spinframework.dev/) and [SpinKube](https://www.spinkube.dev/) project and offers the open source [App Platform](/products/app-platform) to help developers build an IDP more easily.  These tools make it easy to build, test, and deploy applications across cloud, edge, and AI workloads. [https://github.com/akamai-developers](https://github.com/akamai-developers)

#### Is Akamai Cloud a full public cloud or just edge compute?

Akamai Cloud is a full public cloud platform with compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes, serverless, and AI services delivered on a globally distributed architecture.
